data_roles.dev_tune: Development smoke and later formal development evaluation only
data_roles.hard_stress: Locked during development; frozen-method stress evaluation only
data_roles.audit_diagnostic: Membership may be used for identity checks; adjudication remains locked until a future authorized post-Hard phase

DTL-0.definition: Exact Frozen Retrieval identity control; no video, model, or bins

DTL-1.definition: Classify every fixed temporal bin as CORE, CONTEXT, or OUTSIDE, then use the deterministic component-anchor decoder
DTL-1.context_parameter_status: CONTROLLED-CONTEXT REUSE from BR-1 to isolate representation change; 20/120 are not claimed optimal for DTL

model.backend: existing externally managed vLLM OpenAI-compatible server

clip_extraction: Reuse video_clip.extract_video_clip frame-accurate decode/re-encode with actual_source_origin_sec provenance and OpenCV fallback; stream copy forbidden

bin_policy.interval: [0, clip_duration_sec) partitioned at immutable 2-second local edges; final bin may be shorter
bin_policy.precision_statement: DTL-1 v1 does not predict sub-bin boundaries; output edges are real bin edges except the final clip end

label_schema.recall_policy: Prefer CONTEXT over OUTSIDE when uncertain; prefer CORE or CONTEXT over aggressive OUTSIDE
label_schema.confidence_policy: Finite [0,1] diagnostic only; decoder uses no confidence threshold

steps: Split consecutive non-OUTSIDE bins into components
Retain only components containing at least one CORE bin
Retain only components with positive-duration overlap with the original frozen candidate
If none remain, use IDENTITY_FALLBACK and never DROP
Sort by descending parent overlap duration, descending CORE duration, descending CORE bin count, then earliest component start
Use selected first source_start_sec and last source_end_sec as the refined interval
decoder.parent_anchor_rule: Selected component must contain CORE and have overlap_duration_sec > 0 with the original candidate; no tunable parent-tIoU threshold

allowed_model_output: Exactly one {bin_id,label,confidence} object per expected bin; order may differ and is canonicalized
parser_envelope_policy: Development robustness: accept a strict JSON object, a bare bins array, or exactly one complete fenced object/array with optional surrounding prose; bin count, IDs, labels, confidence, duplicates, unknowns, and all content remain strict
forbidden_model_operations: output start/end timestamps or any final interval
drop, create, split, merge, rerank, or rescore candidates
retrieve another highlight or search outside the local window
use references, metrics, Audit adjudication, human labels, or Heldout
replay_policy: Only refined start/end come from localization; candidate ID, score, reason, source, and source_chunk are re-projected from the frozen cache

evaluation_plan.note: No formal promotion gate is frozen in this development draft; user decides after Development Smoke

development_policy.next_step: Development Smoke after explicit user authorization

stopping_rules: Stop on cache, role, protocol, prompt, clip, bin, candidate, decoder, replay, or count mismatch
Stop if DTL-0 is not exact identity over 431 records and 1277 candidates
Stop on Audit adjudication or Heldout access
Stop if model timestamps or non-deterministic decoder logic become necessary
